violations.title: Missing MRP Declaration under Rule 6(1)(e) & Rule 18(1). The package displays 'MRP ₹' but fails to mention the actual price amount and '(incl. of all taxes)' declaration, which is a mandatory requirement for consumer protection against overcharging. Severity: CRITICAL. Recommendation: Immediately cease sale of stock and issue a directive to the manufacturer to include compliant price declarations on all subsequent batches.

Missing Month and Year of Manufacture. Under Rule 6(1)(d), the package must declare the month and year of manufacture or packaging to allow consumers to gauge shelf-life. The field 'PKD:' is present but empty. Severity: MAJOR. Recommendation: Immediate corrective action on printing process.

Incomplete Consumer Care Details. Under Rule 6(1)(g), the package must provide a phone number, email address, and complete physical address for grievances. While a 'CONSUMER CARE CELL' header is visible, the specific contact details are not provided or clearly legible on this panel. Severity: MINOR. Recommendation: Mandate full contact information update.
